fee_notes: Standard Initial Franchise Fee is $35,000 per Store. Reduced to $25,000 for honorably discharged veterans or existing franchisees. First responders (law enforcement, firefighters, EMTs with 10+ years experience) receive a 20% discount. Co-branded TCBY outlets receive a 50% discount on the Initial Franchise Fee. Limited incentive program for existing Mrs. Fields franchisees (until March 31, 2025) reduces fee to $15,000. Under an Area Development Agreement, a Development Fee of $12,500 per additional Store (after the first) is charged, with the remaining $12,500 Initial Franchise Fee due per additional Store before opening. During fiscal year 2023, initial fees actually charged ranged from $2,500 to $35,000. A $10,000 refundable Deposit is required before signing the Franchise Agreement and is applied toward the Initial Franchise Fee.
raw_excerpt: The "Initial Franchise Fee" for an individual unit franchise is $35,000 for each Store. You will pay the Initial Franchise Fee, after applying the Deposit described below (if applicable), when you sign the Franchise Agreement. The Initial Franchise Fee is $25,000 if you are an honorably discharged veteran of the United States military or if you are an existing franchisee. ... During fiscal year 2023, we charged an initial fee ranging from $2,500 to $35,000.
